claude_proposed_widenings.name: resource-less triggered_reaction magic-item ability
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item triggered_reaction family inherits mandatory item resource and reset fields, but this item is an at-will reaction that only spends the wearer’s reaction quota.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage-reduction reaction is gated by having a free hand. Current equipment predicates cover holding/wearing/wielding states, but not an available empty hand.
